AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to requiring the appointment of

summary: Requires the appointment of a Title VI coordinator at every college and university in the state to ensure compliance with Title VI of the federal civil rights act of 1964; requires the division of human rights to develop training for students and employees; requires the Title VI coordinator to notify annually all students and employees of the institution's policies and procedures for reporting discrimination and harassment.
title: Requires the appointment of a Title VI coordinator at every college and university in the state
